base.name: base
base.title: Base Model
base.description: The PCDC data model represents a harmonized consensus data model developed across all participating PCDC disease groups and consortia. It serves as the canonical model from which disease-specific and dataset-specific views are derived.

all.name: all
all.title: Acute Lymphoblastic Leukemia
all.description: The ALL view of the PCDC data model represents consensus data modeling by an international group of pediatric acute lymphoblastic leukemia experts and is maintained by Data for the Common Good (D4CG) at the University of Chicago. It is based on the collective requirements of its contributors.

aml.name: aml
aml.title: Acute Myeloid Leukemia
aml.description: The AML view of the PCDC data model represents consensus data modeling by an international group of pediatric acute myeloid leukemia experts and is maintained by Data for the Common Good (D4CG) at the University of Chicago in collaboration with the International Acute Myeloid Leukemia Consortium (INTERACT). It is based on the collective requirements of its contributors.

cns.name: cns
cns.title: Central Nervous System Tumors
cns.description: The CNS view of the PCDC data model represents consensus data modeling by an international group of pediatric central nervous system tumor experts and is maintained by Data for the Common Good (D4CG) at the University of Chicago in collaboration with the International Central Nervous System Pediatric Research Consortium (INSPiRE). It is based on the collective requirements of its contributors.

ews.name: ews
ews.title: Ewing Sarcoma
ews.description: The EWS view of the PCDC data model represents consensus data modeling by an international group of pediatric Ewing sarcoma experts and is maintained by Data for the Common Good (D4CG) at the University of Chicago in collaboration with the Harmonization International Bone Sarcoma Consortium (HIBiSCus). It is based on the collective requirements of its contributors.

fa.name: fa
fa.title: Fanconi Anemia
fa.description: The FA view of the PCDC data model represents consensus data modeling by an international group of Fanconi Anemia experts and is maintained by Data for the Common Good (D4CG) at the University of Chicago in collaboration with the Fanconi Research Initiative for Education, Networking, and Data Sharing Consortium (FRIENDS). It is based on the collective requirements of its contributors.

fprh.name: fprh
fprh.title: Fertility Preservation and Reproductive Health
fprh.description: The FPRH view of the PCDC data model represents consensus data modeling by an international group of oncology-related fertility preservation and reproductive health experts and is maintained by Data for the Common Good (D4CG) at the University of Chicago in collaboration with the Reproductive Hope Consortium (R-HOPE). It is based on the collective requirements of its contributors.

gct.name: gct
gct.title: Germ Cell Tumors
gct.description: The GCT view of the PCDC data model represents consensus data modeling by an international group of pediatric germ cell tumor experts and is maintained by Data for the Common Good (D4CG) at the University of Chicago in collaboration with the Malignant Germ Cell International Consortium (MaGIC). It is based on the collective requirements of its contributors.

hl.name: hl
hl.title: Hodgkin Lymphoma
hl.description: The HL view of the PCDC data model represents consensus data modeling by an international group of pediatric Hodgkin lymphoma experts and is maintained by Data for the Common Good (D4CG) at the University of Chicago in collaboration with the Hodgkin Lymphoma Data Collaboration (NODAL). It is based on the collective requirements of its contributors.

ls.name: ls
ls.title: Lynch Syndrome
ls.description: The LS view of the PCDC data model represents consensus data modeling by an international group of Lynch Syndrome experts and is maintained by Data for the Common Good (D4CG) at the University of Chicago in collaboration with the Lynch Syndrome Integrative Epidemiology and Genetics Consortium (LINEAGE). It is based on the collective requirements of its contributors.

lt.name: lt
lt.title: Liver Tumors
lt.description: The LT view of the PCDC data model represents consensus data modeling by an international group of pediatric liver tumor experts and is maintained by Data for the Common Good (D4CG) at the University of Chicago in collaboration with the Children's Hepatic Tumors International Collaboration (CHIC). It is based on the collective requirements of its contributors.

nbl.name: nbl
nbl.title: Neuroblastoma
nbl.description: The NBL view of the PCDC data model represents consensus data modeling by an international group of pediatric neuroblastoma experts and is maintained by Data for the Common Good (D4CG) at the University of Chicago in collaboration with the International Neuroblastoma Risk Group (INRG). It is based on the collective requirements of its contributors.

npc.name: npc
npc.title: Nasopharyngeal Carcinoma
npc.description: The NPC view of the PCDC data model represents consensus data modeling by an international group of pediatric nasopharyngeal carcinoma experts and is maintained by Data for the Common Good (D4CG) at the University of Chicago in collaboration with the Nasopharyngeal Carcinoma Global Partnership (NOBLE). It is based on the collective requirements of its contributors.

nrsts.name: nrsts
nrsts.title: Non-rhabdomyosarcoma Soft Tissue Sarcomas
nrsts.description: The NRSTS view of the PCDC data model represents consensus data modeling by an international group of pediatric non-rhabdomyosarcoma soft tissue sarcoma experts and is maintained by Data for the Common Good (D4CG) at the University of Chicago in collaboration with the International Soft Tissue Sarcoma Consortium (INSTRuCT). It is based on the collective requirements of its contributors.

os.name: os
os.title: Osteosarcoma
os.description: The OS view of the PCDC data model represents consensus data modeling by an international group of pediatric osteosarcoma experts and is maintained by Data for the Common Good (D4CG) at the University of Chicago in collaboration with the Harmonization International Bone Sarcoma Consortium (HIBiSCus). It is based on the collective requirements of its contributors.

pre.name: pre
pre.title: Cancer Predisposition
pre.description: The PRE view of the PCDC data model represents consensus data modeling by an international group of cancer predisposition experts and is maintained by Data for the Common Good (D4CG) at the University of Chicago in collaboration with the Consortium for Childhood Cancer Predisposition (C3P). It is based on the collective requirements of its contributors.

rb.name: rb
rb.title: Retinoblastoma
rb.description: The RB view of the PCDC data model represents consensus data modeling by an international group of pediatric retinoblastoma experts and is maintained by Data for the Common Good (D4CG) at the University of Chicago in collaboration with the Global Retinoblastoma Alliance for Children (Global REACH). It is based on the collective requirements of its contributors.

rms.name: rms
rms.title: Rhabdomyosarcoma
rms.description: The RMS view of the PCDC data model represents consensus data modeling by an international group of pediatric rhabdomyosarcoma experts and is maintained by Data for the Common Good (D4CG) at the University of Chicago in collaboration with the International Soft Tissue Sarcoma Consortium (INSTRuCT). It is based on the collective requirements of its contributors.

Person.description: Person represents an internal person-level record used to connect one or more subject records that may refer to the same underlying individual.
comments: This is a PCDC class and is not necessary in exports

Subject.description: Subject represents an enrolled or contributed study participant and captures core identifiers, contributor context, disease group membership, demographic attributes, ancestry-related fields, and selected follow-up status fields.
comments: D4CGNote: One observation/row per instance of a DataContributorPerson being enrolled on a study
(fa) ConsortiumNote: This table is tiered as Mandatory.
(fprh) ConsortiumNote: This table is tiered as Mandatory.
(npc) ConsortiumNote: This table is tiered as Mandatory.

ExternalReference.description: ExternalReference captures links between a PCDC subject and identifiers or URLs in external resources, enabling cross-resource navigation and provenance for linked data assets.
comments: D4CGNote: One observation/row per ___ when instantiated

StudyMetadata.description: StudyMetadata describes the study, registry, trial, institutional database, or other data source context in which a subject or cohort was enrolled or represented.
comments: (fa) ConsortiumNote: This table is tiered as Mandatory.
(fprh) ConsortiumNote: This table is tiered as Mandatory.
(npc) ConsortiumNote: This table is tiered as Mandatory.

StudySubgroupAssignment.description: StudySubgroupAssignment captures a subject's assignment to study strata, treatment arms, risk groups, or other protocol-defined subgroups, including ordering and randomization context where applicable.
comments: (npc) ConsortiumNote: This table is tiered as Mandatory.

ClinicalEpisode.description: ClinicalEpisode represents a longitudinal time period such as a disease phase, treatment course, exam, or related episode used to organize observations across diagnosis, treatment, monitoring, and follow-up.
comments: D4CGNote: One observation/row per time period when instantiated
(fa) ConsortiumNote: This table is tiered as Priority.
(fprh) ConsortiumNote: This table is tiered as Mandatory.
(npc) ConsortiumNote: This table is tiered as Priority.

Consult.description: Consult captures fertility preservation consultation details, including eligibility, reasons for declining consultation or preservation, participants in the consult, interpreter use, insurance type, and consult outcome.
comments: (fprh) ConsortiumNote: This table is tiered as Optional.

OffProtocolTherapyOrStudy.description: OffProtocolTherapyOrStudy records when and why a subject went off protocol therapy, off study, or transitioned to another study, preserving study participation and treatment-discontinuation context.
comments: D4CGNote: If patient went off protocol therapy or study then include an observation.
(npc) ConsortiumNote: This table is tiered as Optional.

SurvivalCharacteristics.description: SurvivalCharacteristics captures last-known survival status, follow-up timing, disease status at last contact, cause of death, and treatment-related mortality details.
comments: D4CGNote: One observation/row per LKSS when instantiated
(fa) ConsortiumNote: This table is tiered as Mandatory.
(fprh) ConsortiumNote: This table is tiered as Priority.
(npc) ConsortiumNote: This table is tiered as Priority.

FamilyMedicalHistory.description: FamilyMedicalHistory captures relevant conditions, procedures, reproductive history, lineage, relationship, and survival information for family members or relatives when family history informs disease risk or interpretation.
comments: D4CGNote: One observation/row per CONDITION when instantiated
(fa) ConsortiumNote: This table is tiered as Priority.

MedicalHistory.description: MedicalHistory records prior or concurrent conditions and selected background health factors for the subject, supporting interpretation of diagnosis, risk, treatment, and outcomes.

SocialAndBehavioralDeterminantsOfHealth.description: SocialAndBehavioralDeterminantsOfHealth captures selected social, behavioral, exposure, gender identity, occupation, marital, and religious-context variables that may influence care, risk, or outcomes.
comments: (fa) ConsortiumNote: This table is tiered as Priority.
(fprh) ConsortiumNote: This table is tiered as Optional.

VitalsAndAnthropometrics.description: VitalsAndAnthropometrics records physical measurements such as anthropometrics, vital measurements, measurement units, values, and gestational age at birth where relevant.
comments: D4CGNote: One observation/row per measurement when instantiated
(fa) ConsortiumNote: This table is tiered as Priority.
(fprh) ConsortiumNote: This table is tiered as Optional.

LaboratoryTest.description: LaboratoryTest captures laboratory assessments and results, including test status, method, specimen, text or numeric result values, units, thresholds, and disease-specific laboratory modifiers.
comments: D4CGNote: One observation/row per result when instantiated
(fa) ConsortiumNote: This table is tiered as Priority.
(fprh) ConsortiumNote: This table is tiered as Priority.
(npc) ConsortiumNote: This table is tiered as Optional.

GeneticAnalysis.description: GeneticAnalysis captures germline and somatic genomic findings, testing context, specimens, methods, genes, variants, copy number, cytogenetic findings, HGVS expressions, significance, inheritance, and related genomic interpretation fields.
comments: D4CGNote: One observation/row per genetic alteration
(fa) ConsortiumNote: This table is tiered as Priority.

Biospecimen.description: Biospecimen describes collected or stored biospecimens, including specimen type, container, media, and available quantity, supporting specimen tracking and downstream research use.
comments: D4CGNote: One observation/row per biospecimen when instantiated

FunctionTest.description: FunctionTest captures functional assessments such as audiology, pulmonary, cardiac, neurologic, or other function-related tests, including result values, units, laterality, grade, and frequency-specific measurements.
comments: D4CGNote: One observation/row per result when instantiated
(fa) ConsortiumNote: This table is tiered as Optional.
(npc) ConsortiumNote: This table is tiered as Optional.

Immunohistochemistry.description: Immunohistochemistry captures marker-level IHC testing, review source, age at assessment, and text or numeric results for pathology-based disease characterization.
comments: D4CGNote: One observation/row per result when instantiated.

Diagnosis.description: Diagnosis captures disease diagnosis and diagnostic assessment details, including timing, review source, diagnosis basis, diagnosis category, morphology, histology, disease-specific diagnostic flags, and transformation information.
comments: (fa) ConsortiumNote: This table is tiered as Mandatory.
(fprh) ConsortiumNote: This table is tiered as Mandatory.
(npc) ConsortiumNote: This table is tiered as Priority.

Staging.description: Staging captures stage, group, TNM, disease extent, and staging-system details used to summarize disease burden and classification at a defined time point.
comments: D4CGNote: One observation/row per STAGE when instantiated.
(fa) ConsortiumNote: This table is tiered as Priority.
(npc) ConsortiumNote: This table is tiered as Priority.
(fprh) ConsortiumNote: This table is tiered as Optional.

DiseaseSiteAssessment.description: DiseaseSiteAssessment captures assessment of tumors, lesions, nodes, sites of disease, measurements, laterality, detection methods, anatomic coding, and disease-specific site findings.
comments: D4CGNote: One observation/row per tumor or lesion when instantiated. Multiple tumors or lesions can be reported in a single obvservation/row if no individual characteristics (e.g. different sites, individual classifications or measurements, etc.) need to be included.
(cns) ConsortiumNote: Not sure COG data will have anything for this table
(ews) ConsortiumNote: For EE99, we will report here only the baseline evaluation. For further disease evaluation, we do not have the description of the detailed lesions
(fa) ConsortiumNote: This table is tiered as Priority.
(npc) ConsortiumNote: This table is tiered as Optional.
(fprh) ConsortiumNote: This table is tiered as Optional.

DiseaseCharacteristics.description: DiseaseCharacteristics captures additional disease-level attributes such as risk group, imaging response scores, performance status, clinical findings, presentation symptoms, and disease-specific biologic or clinical characteristics.
comments: D4CGNote: One observation/row per characteristic when instantiated.
(fa) ConsortiumNote: This table is tiered as Priority.
(fprh) ConsortiumNote: This table is tiered as Priority.

SurgicalProcedures.description: SurgicalProcedures records biopsy, resection, procedural, and surgery-related interventions, including site, laterality, extent, margins, complications, outcome, and disease-specific surgical details.
comments: D4CGNote: One observation/row per procedure when instantiated.
(fa) ConsortiumNote: This table is tiered as Priority.
(npc) ConsortiumNote: This table is tiered as Optional.
(fprh) ConsortiumNote: This table is tiered as Optional.

Medication.description: Medication captures medication exposure and administration details, including chemotherapy or supportive care agents, regimen, route, dose, frequency, cumulative exposure, timing, and protocol or non-protocol context.
comments: D4CGNote: One observation/row per medication administration when instantiated.
(lt) ConsortiumNote: If multiple, include only 5 most recent
(fa) ConsortiumNote: This table is tiered as Priority.
(npc) ConsortiumNote: This table is tiered as Priority.
(fprh) ConsortiumNote: This table is tiered as Priority.

LocoregionalTherapy.description: LocoregionalTherapy captures localized treatment approaches such as embolization or ablation, including technique, dose, administration status, and timing.
comments: D4CGNote: One observation/row per locoregional therapy when instantiated.

ProtocolTreatmentModifications.description: ProtocolTreatmentModifications captures changes to planned protocol therapy, including modification type, basis, reason, toxicity details, and agent substitutions.
comments: D4CGNote: One observation/row per MODIFICATION when instantiated.

RadiationTherapy.description: RadiationTherapy captures radiation treatment timing, site, technique, energy type, dose, fractions, boosts, treatment volume, brachytherapy or plaque details, shielding, and protocol context.
comments: D4CGNote: One observation/row per cycle OR course when instantiated.
(fa) ConsortiumNote: This table is tiered as Priority.
(npc) ConsortiumNote: This table is tiered as Priority.
(fprh) ConsortiumNote: This table is tiered as Priority.

StemCellTransplant.description: StemCellTransplant records hematopoietic stem cell transplant details, including timing, transplant type, donor relationship, HLA matching, conditioning, cell source, CD34 collection or infusion, chimerism, and recovery status.
comments: D4CGNote: One observation/row per SCT when instantiated.
(fa) ConsortiumNote: This table is tiered as Priority.

TransfusionMedicineProcedure.description: TransfusionMedicineProcedure captures transfusion or transfusion-medicine procedures, including product type, procedure type, number of units, and timing.
comments: D4CGNote: One observation/row per transfusion when instantiated.
(fa) ConsortiumNote: This table is tiered as Optional.

CellularImmunotherapy.description: CellularImmunotherapy captures cellular immunotherapy infusions or related immune effector cell interventions and their timing and therapy type.
comments: D4CGNote: One observation/row per infusion when instantiated.

SubjectResponse.description: SubjectResponse captures response assessments across disease sites and treatment time points, including response methods, categories, systems, scores, marrow findings, imaging findings, necrosis, symptoms, and disease-specific response details.
comments: D4CGNote: One observation/row per result when instantiated.
(cns) ConsortiumNote: Will have COG response data for ACNS0334
(npc) ConsortiumNote: This table is tiered as Optional.

MinimalResidualDisease.description: MinimalResidualDisease captures MRD assessments, including method, specimen, result text or numeric value, unit, assay sensitivity, and molecular markers.
comments: D4CGNote: One observation/row per result when instantiated.

AdverseEvents.description: AdverseEvents captures toxicities, complications, infections, GVHD, adverse-event grading, attribution, interventions, hospitalization, outcomes, and other treatment-related safety events.
comments: (fa) ConsortiumNote: This table is tiered as Priority.
(npc) ConsortiumNote: This table is tiered as Optional.

SubsequentMalignantNeoplasm.description: SubsequentMalignantNeoplasm records subsequent malignant neoplasms, including site, type, morphology, topography, coding systems, timing, and radiation-field context where available.
comments: (npc) ConsortiumNote: This table is tiered as Optional.

LateEffects.description: LateEffects captures late effects and survivorship-related outcomes, including evaluation timing, effect type, detail, severity grade, and CTCAE version.

PatientReportedOutcomesMetadata.description: PatientReportedOutcomesMetadata describes patient-reported outcome study instruments, measurement types, raters, time points, and eligible age ranges.

FertilityProcedures.description: FertilityProcedures captures fertility preservation procedures and reproductive tissue handling, including collection, cryopreservation, oocyte, embryo, semen, testicular, ovarian, and surgical procedure details.

ReproductiveOutcomes.description: ReproductiveOutcomes captures pregnancy, conception, tissue utilization, fertility treatment, delivery, birth, and menstrual-status outcomes following cancer therapy or fertility preservation.

demographics.title: Demographics
demographics.description: Demographics contains subject identity, enrollment, study participation, longitudinal episode structure, survival status, family and medical history, and other contextual information needed to interpret records across the model.

testing.title: Testing
testing.description: Testing contains laboratory, pathology, genomic, functional, anthropometric, and specimen-related observations used to characterize subjects, disease biology, eligibility, monitoring, and research sample availability.

disease_attributes.title: Disease Attributes
disease_attributes.description: Disease Attributes contains diagnostic, staging, anatomic, histologic, biologic, risk, extent-of-disease, and disease-site concepts used to characterize the subject's cancer or cancer-related condition.

intervention.title: Intervention
intervention.description: Intervention contains treatment and procedure records, including surgery, medications, radiation therapy, transplantation, transfusion, cellular therapy, locoregional therapy, fertility preservation procedures, and protocol treatment modifications.

monitoring.title: Monitoring
monitoring.description: Monitoring contains response, residual disease, toxicity, late effects, subsequent neoplasms, reproductive outcomes, patient-reported outcomes, and other follow-up concepts used to evaluate disease course and treatment impact over time.
